subject.title: No guard against skill repos created outside canonical paths

question: Should OpenClaw add orphan-skill detection for off-root `SKILL.md` directories, and which scan locations and user-facing surfaces are acceptable?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but scanning outside configured skill roots can expose private paths, add startup cost, and create noisy warnings unless maintainers choose a bounded UX policy.

options.title: Add bounded explicit diagnostic
options.body: Add an explicit skills check or doctor diagnostic for narrowly chosen candidate locations and provide move/install/extraDirs remediation without broad startup scanning.

options.title: Document existing paths only
options.body: Keep runtime behavior unchanged and improve docs around workspace skills, Skill Workshop, `openclaw skills install`, and `skills.load.extraDirs`.

options.title: Warn during startup/status
options.body: Surface off-root `SKILL.md` warnings automatically in startup or status after maintainers accept the privacy and noise tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Add bounded explicit diagnostic
recommendation.body: Add an explicit skills check or doctor diagnostic for narrowly chosen candidate locations and provide move/install/extraDirs remediation without broad startup scanning.

likelyOwner.reason: Most central history on skills CLI, skill-creator, and current skills loading surfaces points to this owner.
